cipher.name: AsciiOffsetByThree
cipher.idea: A simple, highly deterministic character-by-character substitution cipher that shifts the ASCII value of printable characters to disrupt tokenization while remaining extremely easy for LLMs to reason about. It shifts all printable ASCII characters (from space ' ' ASCII 32 to '~' ASCII 126) forward by 3 positions. If the shift exceeds '~' (ASCII 126), it wraps around to the beginning of the printable range starting at ' ' (ASCII 32). All other characters (like newlines) remain unchanged.
